name: Bach Dang Wharf
kicker: The lawn at the end of Nguyễn Huệ
summary: River promenade at the end of Nguyễn Huệ: walk the lawn and the quay for the skyline. The waterbus station is at 10B Tôn Đức Thắng, and the park is about 100 metres from it. Nguyễn Huệ is about 500 metres. The opera is about 600 metres farther on.
timeNeeded: A walk along the quay. Check on arrival.
getThere: Walk Nguyễn Huệ south to the river, about 500 metres.
heroCaption: The lawn and the riverside walk, with the bridge down the bank
body: Bạch Đằng is the river end of Nguyễn Huệ. The waterbus station is at 10B Tôn Đức Thắng, Phường Bến Nghé, Quận 1. The park is about 100 metres from the station, a green walk along the Saigon River with the towers in view, including Landmark 81 and Ba Son Bridge. Nguyễn Huệ is about 500 metres from the station. The opera is about 600 metres, at 07 Công trường Lam Sơn.

The walk on the promenade is the visit. The boat, if you take it, is a separate ticket at the station counter. The photograph is the lawn and the paved walk beside the river. The second frame is the station itself, under the sign Ga tàu thủy Bạch Đằng.

figures.caption: The waterbus station under the sign Ga tàu thủy Bạch Đằng
figures.alt: Bach Dang waterbus station ticket gates

gettingThere: Walk Nguyễn Huệ to the river. About 500 metres from the walking street to 10B Tôn Đức Thắng, and about 100 metres from the station to the park.

legs.heading: From Nguyễn Huệ
legs.body: About 500 metres down the walking street to the river.

legs.heading: From the opera
legs.body: About 600 metres from 07 Công trường Lam Sơn.

admissionNote: Check on arrival for the promenade and for a waterbus fare. Buy a boat ticket at the station counter.
